Firestore rules too. This is a CAMPAIGN, not an allowlist, and
- a file NOT listed here may never exceed the limit;
- a file listed here may never GROW past its recorded count;
- a file listed here that comes back under the limit must be REMOVED,
and the check fails until it is, so this file can only shrink;
- an entry for a path that no longer exists fails too, so a rename
cannot quietly carry an exemption with it.
And this file is not taken on trust either. Every rule above is enforced
against the copy in the branch under test, which that branch may edit, so
scripts/source-size-baseline.mjs also reads the previous version out of git
and refuses any entry ADDED or any count RAISED. CI passes
